title: Prefill: MegaMoE FI NVFP4 (2x8K) + shared-expert side stream
shape: NVFP4 1-node DEP4 slice (step_p.sh -q nvfp4; L24 view: 23 MoE layers; EP16 expert emulation 56/GPU), F16K at L78K, MegaMoE family busy ms per forward (in-step)
basis: MEASURED in-step NVFP4 (step_p -q nvfp4, DEP4 slice, EP16 emulation 56 experts/GPU, L24 view, F16K at L78K, profiled, pf_fam.py): baseline 74.01 (INFRA int-b31121c-1) -> 56.64 (2x8K sub-calls, p-moe-1e85ee4c-1) -> 52.32 (+S3 one-reciprocal SiTU, p-moe-s3-1); achievable 73.33 = nvfp4_modelopt experts + P11/P12 rows (serial sum) at the same 23 layers. Step 218.70 -> 197.16 ms. Real EP16 (4 nodes) pending r7.
gap_analysis: Measured at the EP4-emulated per-GPU shape (runs/P-MOE/r1, r2): vendored megamoe_rubin NVFP4 single 16K launch 2193 us/layer (stage+kernel), 2x8K sub-calls 2124 us (-3.2%, bitwise equal) -> 195.4 ms/step; one 8K call 1077 us. Model (optables P3-16) 2.151 ms/layer at EP16; at the EP4-emulated link volume (0.8x bytes) the same formula gives ~1.6 ms, so the emulated kernel runs ~1.3x its model. Shared MXFP8 expert alone 742 us/layer (68 ms/step) vs model 406 us: the stock SiTU-and-mul alone is 265 us (3 libm tanhf per element) and two MXFP8 quant passes ~70 us. Side-stream overlap of the shared expert does not pay at this shape: the uncapped persistent grid leaves no SMs (2876 vs 2894 serial), and capping the MegaMoE grid by 16/32/48 SMs costs +12.6/+14.3/+22.2% MegaMoE time (best overlap -1.4%). MEASURED root cause (r4): with ALL-LOCAL routing (no NVLink payload) one 8K call still takes 1052 us vs 1065 random: the main kernel is compute/epilogue-bound at ~963 us per 8K call vs model ops 525 us (fc1+act+fc2), ~27% of the FP4 peak; the FC1 epilogue (TMEM load, SiTU 6 MUFU/element, NVFP4 requant) and FC2 token-back are issued by one epilogue warp per SM sub-partition. At EP16 the link time (~0.99 ms per 8K) is of the same size, so the kernel must hide both. In-step the MoE costs ~2.9 ms/layer vs 2.12 standalone: router kernel 0.9 ms/layer in-step (cross-rank arrival skew) vs 0.05 standalone. Shared expert on the production fused SiTU+MXFP8 op: 611 us/layer alone (cuBLASLt MXFP8 gate_up 295 us = ~9.8 PF, fused act 159 us, down 164 us) vs model 406.
inefficiencies: FIXED (landed-ready 055b80ab3d): SiTU core 3 ex2 + 3 rcp MUFU per element -> 2 ex2 + 1 rcp (in-step MegaMoE -7.6%)

Main kernel at the EP4 emulation still 926 us (all-local) / 1006 us (random) per 8K vs ~410 us tensor at 21.1 PF; ~15 GB L2->SM operand traffic per launch at tile 256x256 (weights re-read per 256-token tile; cluster N>1 weight multicast unsupported); neither L2 (~50%) nor tensor (~44%) saturated: pipeline-limited; r13 MMA-warp clock stamps pending

MegaMoE main kernel compute/epilogue-bound: 963 us per 8K call with zero NVLink payload vs model ops 525 us (r4, measured); epilogue issue rate (1 warp/SMSP), SiTU MUFU and NVFP4 requant per tile are the hypothesis (ncu not in the image)
In-step router kernel 0.9 ms/layer vs 0.05 standalone: cross-rank arrival skew charged to MegaMoE (step_p profile)
Top-k reduce 75 us + stage 15 us + router per 8K call outside the persistent kernel (r4 profile)
Shared expert 611 us vs model 406 us (cuBLASLt MXFP8 gate_up ~9.8 PF; fused act 159 us) - side-stream SM-cap overlap measured not profitable (cap costs 12-22% MegaMoE)
FIXED (landed-ready): single 16K-capacity launch -> EP-uniform 2x8K sub-calls (-3.2% standalone, -25% MegaMoE in the slice incl. knob-record selection, arena 947 MiB/rank)
rubin_features: TMA bulk copies over NVLink (pull dispatch, bulk-store combine)
programmatic dependent launch (router -> persistent main kernel)
persistent-grid SM cap / green contexts for side-stream overlap (measured: cap not profitable at this shape)
packed f32x2 FMA + MUFU ex2/rcp in the SiTU epilogue
plan: SOL design (per 16K layer per GPU at EP16, NVFP4): bound = max(link, tensor) with full overlap, not the model's serial sum. Link: P11+P12 ach 0.47+1.67 ms (model rows); tensor fc1+fc2 at 21.1 PF ach 0.82 ms; SiTU 0.07 ms; so a fully overlapped kernel is link-bound at ~2.1-2.2 ms/layer vs model serial 3.19 ms (73.33/23). Minimum kernels: router(+PDL) -> one persistent dispatch/FC1/act/FC2/combine kernel per 8K sub-call -> top-k reduce absorbed (reduce_topk_in_kernel) = 2 launches per sub-call.

Compute side (measured all-local 963 us per 8K main kernel vs 410 us at 21.1 PF): epilogue-bound. Step 1 (r8 probe, running): SiTU MUFU sensitivity stock 6 MUFU/elt vs none vs tanh.approx (3) vs one-reciprocal form (3 ex2 + 1 rcp); if MUFU is a real term, land the 4-MUFU exact-class form (same ex2/rcp approximations, order differs).

Step 2: FC2 epilogue (BF16 token-back of 131K x 7168 values per 8K call per GPU) instruction count per element; probe with stores elided to size it; then widen per-thread TMEM loads / bulk-store path.
Link side: r7 real EP16 (queued, 8n hold) measures 16K vs 2x8K and shared-expert overlap caps 0/-16/-32 where the kernel is link-bound (the EP4 emulation cannot show it).
In-step router 0.9 ms/layer = cross-rank arrival skew: compare per-rank attention time in the NVFP4 slice profile.
